Family-friendly, from the start.

The proposed model is a free core experience and an optional one-time Premium purchase. No subscriptions are planned for the initial release.

01

One household, up to three profiles, basic recurring chores, rewards, reminders and progress.

02

Premium — proposed

More profiles, advanced routines and other extensions are planned. The test target is £3.99 once; this is not an available offer or a confirmed local store price.

03

Adults decide

Purchases must stay in the protected adult area. A live price will come directly from Amazon after product configuration and verification.
